scenes.title: One folder, many kinds of video
scenes.say: Filmlux is one folder that makes many kinds of video. Here is what is inside.

scenes.label: scene types
scenes.say: Seventeen scene types, from titles and charts to screen recordings and custom code.

scenes.title: Choices for every video
